notes: Two classes: 0x7104f726a0 (928 bytes) is the real implementation, used here; 0x710517ae18 (1056 bytes) has only stub slots (all getters return 0 / 0.0, setters return) so it is a null/derived variant, not documented. The constructor is inlined in the fighter module-creation function (allocation of 0x3a0 bytes then stored at boma+0xe0). setup slot 0x28(descriptor {u32 kind, count, parts}, int object id, u8) also registers a 0x28-byte event listener (vtable 0x7104f72888, callback 0x71004c1630) in the boma event list (boma+0x18). Exports reached by vtable without a dossier slot: set_remove_log_attack 0xd8, sleep 0xe8, set_sync_situation 0x110, set_sync_lr 0x118. The +0x10..+0x31f block looks like a generic collision shape set (header + one embedded group), shared with other collision modules; its inner fields beyond those listed are described only by the constructor.
